role: Shared Emuqu scheme: builds the app (watch app built implicitly via target dependency), runs tests through Emuqu.xctestplan, and runs the app with the local StoreKit configuration.
toplevel: Build: single entry Emuqu.app for test/run/profile/archive/analyze, parallelized, implicit dependencies. TestAction: Debug, code coverage enabled only for the Emuqu target, test plan container:Emuqu.xctestplan (default). The scheme lists no test targets directly and sets no launch arguments or environment variables. LaunchAction: Debug, LLDB, allowLocationSimulation YES, storeKitConfigurationFileReference '../../../Emuqu/Configuration.storekit' (resolves to Emuqu/Configuration.storekit), so Xcode Run uses the local StoreKit products; the TestAction has no StoreKit configuration, so unit/UI tests run against whatever StoreKit environment the simulator provides. Profile and Archive use Release.
